fields.description: Issue includes a major editorial and feature coverage of the 1935 Labor Day hurricane disaster in the Florida Keys, emphasizing the deaths of World War I veterans in government camps, criticism of "ordinary precautions" warnings, and failures/delays in evacuation by train. Also reports on Hialeah municipal politics and allegations involving a Federal Savings & Loan Association, publishes Miami traffic fatality statistics and safety commentary, and continues the paper’s "Most Attractive Working Girl" contest featuring winner Miss Evelyn Butler (Kress Store).
